Interface ModelObserver

All Known Subinterfaces:
VirtualView
All Known Implementing Classes:
ClientHandler, ClientHandlerRmi, ClientHandlerSocket
public interface ModelObserver
Observer interface through which the model (and server-side logic) notifies a connected player of game events.

Each method corresponds to a specific type of update. Implementations are responsible for forwarding the notification to the client over the network, updating a local virtual model, or both.

    • injectGameVisitor

      default void injectGameVisitor(GameMessageVisitor visitor)
      Injects a GameMessageVisitor into this observer.

      Parameters:
      visitor - the visitor to inject

    • resetGameVisitor

      default void resetGameVisitor()
      Resets the injected GameMessageVisitor, removing any game-specific message handling from this observer.
